HockeyAllsvenskan — HockeyAllsvenskan site API (hockeyallsvenskan.se, Sweden) — endpoint reference in sdv-py, the SportsDataverse Python package.
Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart
Hand-written wrappers, loaders, and helpers in sportsdataverse.hockey.ha that are not generated API-endpoint wrappers (those have their own reference pages).

ha_player_crosswalk(players: 'Union[pl.DataFrame, Iterable[Any]]', season: 'Optional[int]' = None, game_type: 'str' = 'regular', *, shl_crosswalk: 'Optional[pl.DataFrame]' = None, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False) -> 'Frame' HockeyAllsvenskan player_statnet_id -> the SHL isa id and athlete uuid of the same player. The HA and the SHL share the StatNet player id, so shl_player_id always equals player_statnet_id where the SHL has the player; the lookup adds the SHL athlete uuid and confirms the player appears in that SHL season. Parameters Returns polars.DataFrame | pandas.DataFrame: one row per distinct player id: player_statnet_id and shl_player_id (Int64; null when the SHL season has no such player), athlete_uuid, full_name and date_of_birth from the SHL. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.hockey.ha import ha_leaders, ha_player_crosswalk ha_player_crosswalk(ha_leaders(), season=2026)

The current season's games (CMS records, decoded from the schedule page): slug, StatNet game number and team ids, start time, score. Endpoint URL: GET https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/pages/matcher Valid URL: https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/pages/matcher
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's CMS record by slug (2025/26 onward): StatNet game number and team ids, scores by period, venue, attendance. Endpoint URL: GET https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/game Valid URL: https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/game?slug=20260918-aik-modo
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One game's events (2025/26 onward): shots with outcome, goals with assists and strength, penalties, goalkeeper changes, timeouts. No coordinates, no on-ice players. Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/play-by-play Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/play-by-play' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"statNetGameNumber": 23401, "homeStatNetId": "AIK", "awayStatNetId": "MODO", "scheduledDateTime": "2026-09-18T17:00:00.000Z"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Every game of a season, played or scheduled (is_played): date, display team codes, score, periods, arena, attendance, shots and power play. No game id. Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-games-stats Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-games-stats' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"season": "2025", "phase": "HA", "team_side": "all", "team": "all", "against_team": "all", "all_results": "all", "game_status": "all", "decided_in": "all"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Standings of a season. Wins and losses are REGULATION only; overtime counts include shootouts. Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/league-standings-all-time Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/league-standings-all-time' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"season": "2025", "phase": "HA", "location": "all"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Skater stats of a season, one category (column set) per call. Names and StatNet team ids, no player ids. Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-skaters-stats Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-skaters-stats' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"season": "2025", "phase": "HA", "categories": "summary", "position": "all", "ages": "all", "team_side": "all", "team": "all", "against_team": "all", "all_results": "all", "game_status": "all", "decided_in": "all"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Goalkeeper stats of a season, one category per call. Names and StatNet team ids, no player ids. Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-goalkeepers-stats Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-goalkeepers-stats' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"season": "2025", "phase": "HA", "categories": "summary", "team_side": "all", "team": "all", "against_team": "all", "all_results": "all", "game_status": "all", "decided_in": "all"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Team stats of a season, one category per call. W / L are totals including overtime and shootout (wins_total / losses_total). Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-teams-stats Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-teams-stats' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"season": "2025", "phase": "HA", "categories": "results", "team_side": "all", "team": "all", "against_team": "all", "all_results": "all", "game_status": "all", "decided_in": "all"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Teams of a season with both team keys: StatNet team id <-> display code (from the stats tables' teams list). Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-goalkeepers-stats Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-time-goalkeepers-stats' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"season": "2025", "phase": "HA"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Current-season top 25 of one metric, with the StatNet player id (the only stats route that has one). Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/player-leaderboard Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/player-leaderboard' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"metric": "TP", "phase": "HA"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

One team's players from the CMS directory: CMS ids, position, jersey, birth date, size, headshots. One team per call (league-wide paging is unreliable). Endpoint URL: POST https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-players Example request: curl -X POST 'https://hockeyallsvenskan.se/api/all-players' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"teamShortName": "AIK", "orderBy": "familyName"}'
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
